purpose: Establish the bend-task oracle key ('pass') independently of the plugin: official Bend run directly on the committed fixture, no Hermes, no plugin code (DEVIATIONS D7, disclosed extension after the results commit).
env: hostless; env -i PATH=<LEAN_4_34_0_BIN>:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<ORACLE_KEY_DIR>/home (fresh, empty: kernel built cold) TMPDIR=<ORACLE_KEY_DIR>/tmp BEND_LIB=<ORACLE_KEY_DIR>/lib (empty) BEND_HUB=http://127.0.0.1:0 LANG=C.UTF-8; timeout 900
boundary: This shows that official Bend 2.0.34 itself says the fixture's emitted book checks, so the oracle key 'pass' does not come from the plugin. It is still a kernel verdict over the emitted book (source_semantics_attested false), not task success, and it is the same Bend/kernel identity the plugin used (a7e5203d), so it does not independently check Bend.
